snippet.title: S.P.E.A.R. – Launch Trailer | Available January 9th, 2026 on Xbox Series X|S
snippet.description:
It all starts like a classic fairytale:
you’re a knight in shining armor, the crowd is cheering…
and then the game crashes.

Welcome to S.P.E.A.R., a fast-paced 2.5D action-platformer where glitches and bugs are tearing a videogame world apart.

Everyone is gone.
Well, almost everyone.

You play as Default, a forgotten NPC armed with a makeshift spear built from a broom and a mouse cursor.
Fight corrupted enemies, uncover hidden secrets, collect pieces of code, and stop the developers from deleting the whole project.

Explore a rich 3D overworld, unlock secret challenges, battle twisted mini-bosses, and dive into a world that knows it’s about to be erased.

S.P.E.A.R. is available January 9th 2026 on Xbox Series X|S.
